notes: Paper bounds exceptionally light QCD axions via white-dwarf mass-radius relation (NOT axion-electron; the pre-analysis hint is wrong). The result lives on the axion parameter space plane of decay constant f (GeV) vs mass m_a (eV), Fig.1 - i.e. an AxionMass-type bound, driven by the axion-gluon/nucleon (sigma-term) coupling, independent of DM. The exclusion is a 2D region in {epsilon, f}, not a simple line. Clean quoted numbers: 2e-20 < epsilon < 2e-7 (negligible-gradient regime) and 5.5e9 < f/GeV < 1.1e16 (negligible-epsilon regime), both 95% CL; ZN model excludes 33<=N<=69. Emitted the f-interval endpoints (mass sentinel 0) since a proper boundary curve cannot be reliably reconstructed from text. m_a relates via m_a^2 = epsilon*m_pi^2*f_pi^2/f^2.
